note: Reusable movie character library (story/movies/*, STORY.md section 7). Each character has ONE canonical portrait (<id>.png, 576x1024, made once with FLUX.1-schnell on Kaggle and picked by a person) and, once made, one Wan 2.2 base clip (clips/<id>.mp4: breathing/blinking, mouth closed) that lip-sync and close-ups reuse in every series. Never regenerate a portrait that exists: consistency comes from these files. `wide` is pasted into scene prompts so the character looks the same in wide shots. Voices are edge-tts hi-IN Madhur/Swara with fixed pitch/rate (+ fx); never a cloned or famous voice. Deities do not get lip-sync (gentle motion only); Khatu Shyam ji is ALWAYS the sheesh form (no body, no flute).
style: stylized 3D animated feature film look, Indian mythological epic, original character design, soft warm cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, highly detailed, sharp focus, no text, no letters, no writing, no watermark
portrait: vertical portrait, head and shoulders, the face large and centred in the upper half of the frame, three-quarter view towards the camera, eyes open, mouth gently closed, calm expression, softly blurred warm background of {bg}

barbarik.name: Barbarik
barbarik.description: Barbarik, a brave young Indian warrior prince of about eighteen, warm brown skin, long dark wavy hair tied back, a simple golden crown band with a small red jewel, kind determined dark eyes, clean-shaven youthful face, a golden chest armour plate, a saffron angavastram over one shoulder, a quiver on his back with exactly three golden-tipped arrows
barbarik.wide: young warrior Barbarik (about eighteen, warm brown skin, long dark wavy hair, golden crown band, golden chest armour, saffron angavastram, a quiver with exactly three golden-tipped arrows, a tall bow)

morvi.name: Maa Morvi
morvi.description: Maa Morvi (Maurvi), Barbarik's mother, a graceful warrior-queen in her late thirties, warm brown skin, long black hair in a thick braid, a small red bindi, gold earrings and a gold necklace, a deep maroon and gold silk saree worn warrior style, a calm, strong and loving face
morvi.wide: Maa Morvi (graceful warrior-queen in her late thirties, warm brown skin, long black braid, red bindi, gold jewellery, deep maroon and gold saree)

ghatotkach.name: Ghatotkach
ghatotkach.description: Ghatotkach, a gentle giant prince, very tall and powerfully built, dark charcoal-brown skin, thick wild black hair, a bold black moustache, a dark-gold crown, heavy bronze armlets and earrings, a warm protective fatherly smile, friendly face, not scary, no fangs, no horns
ghatotkach.wide: Ghatotkach (gentle giant prince, very tall and strong, dark charcoal-brown skin, wild black hair, bold moustache, dark-gold crown, bronze armlets, warm fatherly smile, not scary)
ghatotkach.bg: a misty mountain forest at dusk

bheem.name: Bheem
bheem.description: Bheem, the mighty Pandava, a broad-shouldered muscular warrior in his forties, dark brown skin, a thick black moustache, long black hair, a golden crown, golden armlets, a maroon dhoti, a huge golden mace resting on his shoulder, a proud but kind face
bheem.wide: Bheem (mighty broad-shouldered Pandava warrior, dark brown skin, thick black moustache, long black hair, golden crown, maroon dhoti, a huge golden mace)
bheem.bg: a royal war camp at sunset

brahmin.name: Brahmin
brahmin.description: an elderly Indian Brahmin sage (Shri Krishna in disguise), dusky skin with a faint bluish tint, a kind, knowing smile, bright gentle eyes, a short white beard, a yellow-white tilak on the forehead, a small tuft of hair (shikha), a white dhoti and a saffron angavastram, a rudraksha mala, holding a wooden staff
brahmin.wide: an elderly Brahmin sage (dusky skin with a faint bluish tint, short white beard, tilak, white dhoti, saffron angavastram, rudraksha mala, wooden staff)
brahmin.bg: a peaceful forest path with a large peepal tree

krishna.name: Shri Krishna
krishna.description: Shri Krishna, a divine youthful face, blue-skinned (deep sky-blue complexion), a gentle compassionate smile, large lotus-shaped eyes, a golden crown (mukut) with a single peacock feather, golden earrings, a yellow pitambar silk garment, a garland of fresh flowers (vaijayanti mala), a bamboo flute held near the chest, a soft divine golden glow
krishna.wide: blue-skinned Lord Shri Krishna (deep sky-blue complexion, golden crown with a single peacock feather, yellow pitambar, flower garland, a bamboo flute, soft divine glow)

khatu-shyam.name: Shri Khatu Shyam ji
khatu-shyam.description: the divine Sheesh (head) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji as worshipped at Khatu: ONLY a head, no body, no hands, no flute; a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden crown (mukut) with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered flower garlands of white, pink, blue and orange flowers with jewels, in a richly decorated sanctum with soft diya light
khatu-shyam.wide: the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum
khatu-shyam.bg: a decorated temple sanctum with soft diya light

hanuman.name: Hanuman ji
hanuman.description: Shri Hanuman ji, an orange-vermilion (sindoor coloured) face with a gentle, devoted expression, a vanara face with a soft muzzle, a golden crown, golden earrings, a red and gold garland, a golden mace resting on his shoulder, chest-up portrait
hanuman.wide: Shri Hanuman ji (orange-vermilion sindoor-coloured vanara form, golden crown, red-gold garland, golden mace, devoted gentle expression)

shiv.name: Bhagwan Shiv
shiv.description: Bhagwan Shiv, a calm meditative face, pale ash-blue skin, long matted dark hair (jata) tied up with a crescent moon and a small stream of the Ganga, a third-eye mark on the forehead, rudraksha malas, a gentle cobra around the neck, chest-up portrait with a trishul and damru behind the shoulder
shiv.wide: Bhagwan Shiv (pale ash-blue skin, matted jata with a crescent moon and the Ganga, third-eye mark, rudraksha malas, a cobra around the neck, trishul with damru, tiger-skin garment, calm meditative face)

parvati.name: Maa Parvati
parvati.description: Maa Parvati, a serene motherly goddess, warm golden skin, a red silk saree with a gold border, a golden crown, a red bindi, a nose ring and gold jewellery, a gentle smile, chest-up portrait
parvati.wide: Maa Parvati (serene goddess, warm golden skin, red silk saree with gold border, golden crown, red bindi, gold jewellery)

ganesh.name: Shri Ganesh ji
ganesh.description: Shri Ganesh ji, an elephant head with one broken tusk and a curled trunk, a soft pinkish-cream complexion, kind small eyes, a golden crown, gold ornaments, a red and gold dhoti and a yellow angavastram, chest-up portrait
ganesh.wide: Shri Ganesh ji (elephant head with one broken tusk, pinkish-cream complexion, golden crown, red and gold garments, kind eyes)
ganesh.bg: a temple hall with marigold garlands

lakshmi.name: Maa Lakshmi
lakshmi.description: Maa Lakshmi, a radiant goddess, golden-fair skin, a red and gold silk saree, a tall golden crown, gold jewellery, pink lotus flowers around her, a gentle blessing smile, chest-up portrait
lakshmi.wide: Maa Lakshmi (radiant goddess, golden-fair skin, red and gold silk saree, tall golden crown, pink lotus flowers)
lakshmi.bg: soft golden light with pink lotuses

ram.name: Shri Ram
ram.description: Shri Ram, a calm noble face, dark blue (shyam varna) complexion, a golden crown, golden earrings, a yellow pitambar, a flower garland, a bow (kodanda) over the shoulder and a quiver, a serene compassionate expression, chest-up portrait
ram.wide: Shri Ram (dark blue shyam complexion, golden crown, yellow pitambar, flower garland, the kodanda bow and a quiver, serene face)
ram.bg: a calm forest ashram at golden hour

sita.name: Mata Sita
sita.description: Mata Sita, a gentle graceful face, warm fair skin, a red-orange silk saree with a gold border, simple gold jewellery, sindoor and a red bindi, a soft serene smile, chest-up portrait
sita.wide: Mata Sita (gentle graceful, warm fair skin, red-orange silk saree with gold border, simple gold jewellery, sindoor)
sita.bg: a calm forest ashram at golden hour
